title: Understanding the Capabilities and Limitations of Large Language Models for Cultural Commonsense

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on culture-specific commonsense question answering and country prediction tasks across five different cultures (US, China, India, Iran, Kenya), and measuring the disproportionate association of general commonsense statements with dominant cultures.

Evaluating and comparing model performance on cultural and general commonsense tasks when prompted in English versus the native languages associated with the target cultures (Chinese, Hindi, Farsi, Swahili).
